name: Stony Meteorite
description: Photorealistic stony meteorite (chondrite), about 31 cm long, without texture maps: black-brown fusion crust with regmaglypts, and a broken corner that shows the grey interior with chondrules, rust stains and metal flecks. Detail comes from geometry, vertex colours with baked ambient occlusion, and three materials. Meshopt-compressed: apps need three.js MeshoptDecoder.
author: NodePrism
